overall_summary: The channel has a very small sample size with overall low view counts (max 40 views). However, content touching upon 'self respect' (e.g., AfaLxMy6FMY with 40 views and aNR94Xxn0yM with 26 views) shows slightly better baseline performance compared to pure sad or overthinking hooks.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'चैट डिलीट करने की हिम्मत' (40 views) and 'बिना नाम का नंबर' (26 views) performed relatively better than abstract late-night thoughts.
winning_patterns.action: Focus more narratives on personal empowerment, dignity, and making the hard choice to let go.

winning_patterns.pattern: Tangible, physical phone actions in hooks
winning_patterns.evidence: Hooks mentioning specific smartphone interactions (e.g., 'उंगली उसी चैट पर रुकी थी', 'बिना नाम के सेव किया था नंबर') ground the emotion quickly.
winning_patterns.action: Continue using concrete, everyday digital habits as hook triggers.

weak_patterns.evidence: Hooks like 'रात के दो बजे' or 'मेज पर रखी चाय ठंडी हो गई' yielded very low views (5-12 views).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid purely abstract time-of-night openings without a specific, actionable object or digital trigger.
